entities.name: Elvira Gascón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elvira Gascón Vera was a Spanish painter, drafter, and engraver who participated in the Mexican muralism movement and is known for synthesizing Spanish and Mexican styles. Gascón also illustrated hundreds of books and periodicals, originating the drawing style known as helenismo picassiano.

entities.name: Elvira Gascón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elvira Gascón Vera was a Spanish painter, drafter, and engraver who participated in the Mexican muralism movement and is known for synthesizing Spanish and Mexican styles. Gascón also illustrated hundreds of books and periodicals, originating the drawing style known as helenismo picassiano.
